name: Doki Doki Pokenronpa
source:
You play as Aurin, a shiny Riolu, enjoying peace in the lake. Then a weird shadow figure with glowing red eyes knocks you out. You wake up, evolve, and are with 16 other shiny Pokemon. It's your choice how you want to leave this place: to be single forever or get along with someone, your choice, or to do something differently fully.

[From [url=https://foxboxxx.itch.io/doki-doki-pokenronpa]itch.io[/url]]
